notes: This page contains the Saturday sixth-part heading and an ornament border. A white English digitization overlay crossing the ornament is not printed book text and is omitted.

corrections.reason: The printed form appears to omit ስ from the phrase meaning ‘you who are sanctified.’

uncertain.why: The small interior detail of ኻ is faint and may instead be ካ.
The middle glyphs are faint near the bottom of the scan; this is the best visual reading.

clipped.note: The final line is sliced by the bottom edge; only its upper portion is visible and it appears to begin 'ጋር'. The line is omitted.

spans.t: ሆይ የተባረክሽ ነሽ። የማኅፀንሽም ፍሬ የተባረከ ነው። ጸጋን የተመላሽ ሆይ
ካንቺ ጋር ነውና ደስ ይበልሽ እያልን መልአኩ
ቅዳሜ የሚጸለይ አምላክን የወለደች የአመቤታችን የድንግል ማርያም ምስጋና
ንጽሕት ነሽ ብርህትም ነሽ፡፡ ጌታን በመኻል እጅሽ የያዝሽው ሆይ በሁሉ የተቀደሽ ነሽ፡፡ ፍጥረት ሁሉ
ብለው እየጮኹ ካንቺ ጋር ደስ ይላቸዋል::
